outcome: Listening room programme P1 (O12-PRESENTER): an optional station presenter in the desktop app. It writes brief links from captured metadata through OpenAI-compatible writing and speech endpoints and plays them between tracks on a speech layer of its own, within a per-station budget. Music continues when a provider fails. Judged against coordinator rulings and an independently authored acceptance probe (o12pr).

criteria: Probe o12pr: 25 passed, 0 failed on the landing merge (coordinator run). Revisions R1-R6 print each original check through superseded().

Full acceptance on the landing tree (all 15 manifest suites, a condition set by the O11 coordinator): the first run on the merge failed o10l (7) and o11s (1) on the narrow-width layout regression described below, and o4 2c as a load flake. Final run at a7d0b1d: all 15 suites 'ok' against their known-failure lists except o10p G14 (60 ms of media-thread CPU against a 50 ms limit under load), which passed at 0 ms when o10p was rerun alone. o12pr 25/0, o10l 126/0, o11s 68/0.
Full unit suite, nix build and nix flake check: exit 0 on the landing tree.
acceptance.note: Rulings 1-21 settle the brief's ambiguities. repairs.note: Major: 'played' was recorded when a segment was prepared, not when its slot started (also caught by probe P1f). Minor: no primary-speech recheck at the slot; a silent 2 MiB truncation of speech responses; unexpected preparation exceptions swallowed; import and helper cleanups; README and CHANGELOG placement and wording. The implementer repaired the first four, the cleanups, slot counting from capped history (ruling 20) and the swallowed connection KeyError. The coordinator repaired the docs (abb8ecd) and the narrow-width regression found by the full acceptance (2de5b1d).

cost.source: Worker tokens as reported: Sonnet implementer about 251k, Sonnet acceptance author about 198k. Codex token counts were not captured. Coordinator output tokens are about 510k, from the session transcript; input and cache tokens were not summed.

practice_observation: Codex did not deliver this GTK outcome. Terra quit after about 10 min twice and overstated its results. Sol progressed but hit the Codex usage limit. The agentops dispatch status file records the starting head, not the final one, and Codex sandboxes stall on the full suite, nix build and GTK probes. A Claude Sonnet subagent delivered, but a swallowed KeyError (patched test config without the presenter keys) cost a full round, and the subagent stalled silently for 10 h after a killed build. A dispatch heartbeat or deadline would have surfaced that sooner. Giving a fresh acceptance author the implementer's claims to verify, rather than fixes to apply, worked in one round and found a real defect on its own. Probe-only acceptance missed a cross-suite regression (narrow-width layout) that the full multi-suite acceptance on the landing merge caught, so a full acceptance before landing is worth its cost on this repository. One outcome is not a comparative model-quality claim.
